app.name: Slouchcat
app.tagline: Films, series, audiobooks and podcasts for your household.

server.checking: Checking the connection to the server …

page.title: Slouchcat cannot be reached right now
page.body: The server does not answer. Check that the container is running, then try again.

code.invalid_credentials: E-mail address or password is wrong.
code.library_path_invalid: This folder does not exist on the server or cannot be read. Enter an absolute path inside the container.
code.tmdb_key_invalid: TMDB rejected the key. Check the read access token.
code.tmdb_unreachable: TMDB cannot be reached right now. Try again or leave the field empty.
code.setup_done: Slouchcat is already set up. Please sign in.
code.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
code.forbidden: This account is not allowed to do that.
code.csrf_header_missing: The request was rejected for security reasons. Reload the page.
code.channel_unavailable: This channel is not set up on the server.
code.channel_disabled: The channel is switched off or not connected yet.
code.event_not_allowed: Only the main user receives error reports.
code.send_failed: The message was not sent: the service refused it or did not answer.
code.push_unavailable: Web Push is not set up on the server.
code.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
code.transcode_busy: The server is busy. Please try again later.
code.pin_required: This profile is protected by a PIN.
code.pin_locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again later.
code.primary_profile_required: Only the primary profile of this account manages profiles.
code.primary_profile: The primary profile cannot be deleted.
code.invitation_gone: This invitation link is no longer valid.
code.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
code.provider_not_configured: This provider is not set up. Add its key to the server configuration.
code.watch_limit_reached: This profile has used up today's watch time.
code.stream_limit_reached: This profile already plays as many streams as allowed.
code.device_required: This device is not known for the session. Sign in again.
code.download_not_ready: The download is still being prepared on the server.
code.download_evicted: The prepared file is no longer on the server. It is being prepared again.
code.feed_unreachable: The feed cannot be reached. Check the address and try again.
code.feed_invalid: There is no RSS podcast feed at this address.
code.feed_exists: This library already subscribes to the feed.
code.rating_below_library_default: The age rating must not be below the library's default.
code.not_listable: Seasons and extras cannot be put on the watchlist.
code.not_favoritable: Only series and podcasts can be favourites.
code.not_editable: Collections from TMDB cannot be changed.

field.not_absolute: Enter an absolute path; it starts with /.
field.too_many_profiles: An account can have at most 10 profiles.
field.already_exists: This e-mail address is already taken.
field.not_burnable: This subtitle track cannot be burned in.
field.invalid_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.

setup.title: Welcome to Slouchcat
setup.intro: Three short steps, then Slouchcat scans your first library.

account.title: Main account
account.description: You manage Slouchcat with this account.

library.title: First library
library.description: You can add more libraries later.
library.name: Name
library.pathHint: Absolute path inside the container, for example /media/Movies.

tmdb.title: Metadata from TMDB (optional)
tmdb.description: With a read access token from themoviedb.org Slouchcat fetches overviews, posters and age ratings. Without a key, titles come from the file names.
tmdb.label: API read access token
tmdb.hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in with your Slouchcat account.

library.defaultRatingHint: Applies to every title of this library. Single titles can only be rated stricter afterwards.
library.podcastsHint: Podcasts need no folder: you subscribe to their feeds under Podcasts.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: Your films appear here as soon as a library has been scanned.

notFound.title: Title not found
notFound.body: This title does not exist or no longer exists.

file.title: File
file.none: No file is available for this title right now.

unsupported.title: Format cannot be played
unsupported.body: This browser cannot play this format.

error.title: Playback not possible
error.body: The file could not be loaded.

watchLimit.title: Today's watch time is used up
watchLimit.body_one: This profile may watch {{count}} minute a day. See you tomorrow.
watchLimit.body_other: This profile may watch {{count}} minutes a day. See you tomorrow.
watchLimit.bodyUnknown: This profile reached its daily limit. See you tomorrow.

streamLimit.title: Too many streams at once
streamLimit.body_one: This profile may play {{count}} stream at a time. Stop another playback and try again.
streamLimit.body_other: This profile may play {{count}} streams at a time. Stop another playback and try again.
streamLimit.bodyUnknown: This profile already plays as many streams as allowed. Stop another playback and try again.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.intro: Folders Slouchcat watches and the state of their scans.

error.root_missing: The folder is missing. Is the drive mounted? Nothing was deleted.
error.root_empty: The folder is empty. Nothing was deleted.
error.loss_over_threshold: More than 20 % of the files are missing. Nothing was deleted to be safe.
error.cancelled: The scan was cancelled. The next scan runs normally again.

acceptLoss.title: Remove missing files?
acceptLoss.body: The next scan removes the missing titles from the library; progress for these titles is lost. Only do this when the files were deleted on purpose.

libraries.noRoots: No folder: the titles come from subscribed feeds.

changeRating.label: Change the default rating of {{name}}
changeRating.title: Default rating of {{name}}
changeRating.description: Every title whose rating comes from the library follows at once. Ratings set by hand stay.
changeRating.saved: The default rating of {{name}} is now {{rating}}.

access.title: Access
access.intro: Invite guests with a one-time link and decide what they may watch.

notAllowed.title: Main account only
notAllowed.body: Invitations and guests are managed in the primary profile of the main account.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.intro: A link works once and for seven days. Whoever opens it creates a guest account of their own.
invitations.noteHint: For example a name. The guest sees the note too.

created.title: Invitation link created
created.once: Copy the link now: it is shown only this once.
created.label: Invitation link
created.copyFailed: Copying is not possible. The link is selected, copy it with Ctrl+C.

guests.title: Guests
guests.intro: Guests have an account of their own with a ceiling and libraries. Their profiles stay below it.

remove.title: Remove guest {{email}}?
remove.body: Account, profiles and progress are deleted. Running sessions and playback end immediately. Downloads on the guest's devices disappear at their next contact with the server. A device that never comes online again keeps them.

guests.limitsHint: Applies to every profile of the guest account.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.intro: Titles and files that need attention.

notAllowed.title: Main account only
notAllowed.body: Library maintenance is reserved for the primary profile of the main account.

hint.unmatched: Without a match there is no description, artwork or rating. Match the title or refresh it.
hint.no_images: Matched titles without a poster. A refresh loads the artwork again.
hint.unrated: Titles without a rating are seen only by 18-rated profiles. Assign a rating to release them.
hint.orphaned: Titles without a file or with missing files, empty seasons and series.
hint.unplayable: Files that cannot be read. Check them again or remove them from the library.
hint.rating_mismatch: The stored rating differs from the computed one. A rating change or the next scan corrects it. There is nothing to select here.
hint.duplicates: Titles that exist twice. Pick the title to keep and merge the others into it.

done.match: Match saved, the metadata is being loaded.

cleanup.title: Clean up titles?
cleanup.body_one: The selected title is removed from the library. Files on disk stay untouched.
cleanup.body_other: The {{count}} selected titles are removed from the library. Files on disk stay untouched.

remove.title: Remove files?
remove.body_one: The selected file is removed from the library and skipped by future scans. It stays on disk.
remove.body_other: The {{count}} selected files are removed from the library and skipped by future scans. They stay on disk.

duplicates.confirmBody_one: Files, extras, trailers and progress of the other title move to “{{title}}”. The other title is deleted.
duplicates.confirmBody_other: Files, extras, trailers and progress of the {{count}} other titles move to “{{title}}”. The other titles are deleted.

item.title: Manage title

notAllowed.title: Main account only
notAllowed.body: Titles are managed by the primary profile of the main account.

item.notFound: This title does not exist or no longer exists.

trailers.title: Trailers
trailers.urlHint: youtube.com/watch?v=…, youtu.be/… or the video id.
trailers.langCodeHint: Two or three lower-case letters, for example fr.

delete.title: Delete trailer?
delete.body: The trailer is removed. An automatically found trailer may come back with the next refresh.

match.title: Match title
match.description: Search TMDB or TVDB for the title and pick the right entry.

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: Browsers and devices that signed in, with the capability profile of their last playback start.

forget.label: Forget {{name}}
forget.title: Forget the device “{{name}}”?
forget.body: Running streams end and the device's sessions are signed out. If it is the device you are using right now, you are signed out here at once.

streams.title: Streams
streams.intro: Running playbacks. The list refreshes every 5 seconds.

stop.label: Stop the stream of {{profile}}
stop.title: Stop the stream of {{profile}}?
stop.body: Playback of “{{title}}” stops on the device within seconds.

podcasts.title: Podcasts
podcasts.intro: Subscribed feeds. Slouchcat fetches every feed hourly and adds new episodes.
podcasts.noLibrary: Add a library of the kind Podcasts first.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to feed
subscribe.description: Slouchcat fetches the feed right away and adds the podcast with its episodes.
subscribe.urlHint: RSS feed of the podcast, for example https://example.org/feed.xml.

remove.label: Unsubscribe from {{title}}
remove.title: Unsubscribe from {{title}}?
remove.body: The podcast and its episodes disappear from the library. Downloads of the episodes are removed at the next sync.

picks.title: Cat's picks
picks.intro: Titles in the start page carousel, for every profile or for single ones. Each profile only sees titles of its age rating and only within the chosen time window.
picks.empty: No picks yet. Without picks the start page shows no carousel.

search.label: Search titles
search.hint: Two characters or more: films, series, episodes, audiobooks and podcasts.

targets.label: For
targets.description: All profiles or single ones. A profile only sees the pick when it may see the title.
targets.required: Choose “All profiles” or at least one profile.

form.noteHint: Shown in the carousel below the title, at most {{max}} characters.
form.windowHint: Leave empty: from now on and without end.
form.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

add.title: Add a pick
add.description: Search a title and choose who it is recommended to. New picks go to the end.
add.presetMissing: The title of the link no longer exists. Search it again.

remove.label: Remove {{title}}
remove.title: Remove {{title}} from Cat's picks?
remove.body: The title stays in the library; only the pick goes.

collections.title: Collections
collections.intro: Collections from TMDB appear by themselves when titles are matched and cannot be changed. Put together your own collections here.

create.title: New collection
create.description: An empty collection. Add its titles afterwards under “Members”.

remove.label: Delete collection {{name}}
remove.title: Delete collection {{name}}?
remove.body: The titles stay in the library; only the collection goes.

members.label: Members of {{name}}
members.title: Members of {{name}}
members.description: Search titles and add them; the order here is the collection's order.
members.empty: No titles in this collection yet.

search.label: Search titles
search.hint: Two characters or more: films, series, audiobooks and podcasts.

homeRows.title: Start page
homeRows.intro: Order of the start page rows, for every profile. Hidden and empty rows do not appear.
homeRows.moved: {{row}} is now at position {{position}}. Save to apply it.

trakt.title: Trakt
trakt.intro: The Trakt lists “Trending” and “Popular”, fetched once a day with the server's key. Slouchcat sends nothing to Trakt.
trakt.notConfigured: Trakt is not set up: without a client id (SLOUCHCAT_TRAKT_CLIENT_ID) the Trakt rows stay away.
trakt.queued: The Trakt lists are being fetched.

libraries.loadFailed: The libraries could not be loaded.

picker.title: Who's watching?
picker.loadFailed: The profiles could not be loaded.

pin.title: PIN for {{name}}
pin.intro: This profile is protected by a PIN.
pin.label: PIN
pin.invalid: The PIN is wrong. Try again.
pin.locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in

settings.title: Profiles
settings.intro: Everyone in the household gets a profile of their own with age rating, language, colour and libraries.

onlyPrimary.title: Primary profile only
onlyPrimary.body: You manage profiles in the primary profile of this account. Switch to it to add or change profiles.

delete.title: Delete profile "{{name}}"?
delete.body: Progress and settings of this profile are lost. This cannot be undone.

pin.title: PIN for {{name}}
pin.label: New PIN
pin.hint: 4 to 8 digits. Without the PIN the profile cannot be opened.

remove.title: Remove the PIN of {{name}}?
remove.body: Afterwards anyone can open this profile without a PIN.

form.name: Name
form.ratingHint: Titles with a higher rating stay invisible to this profile.

report.title: Watch time of {{name}}
report.intro: Minutes per day over the last 30 days.

invite.title: Invitation to Slouchcat
invite.intro: Create your account and you can start right away.

form.profileNameHint: What your profile is called, for example your first name.

gone.title: Link no longer valid
gone.body: This link was already used, has expired or was withdrawn. Ask whoever invited you for a new link.

notFound.title: Link not found
notFound.body: This invitation link does not exist. Check that you copied all of it.

trailer.title: Trailer: {{title}}
trailer.privacy: The trailer is played by YouTube (youtube-nocookie.com).

notFound.title: Person not found
notFound.body: There are no titles for this person here.

limits.title: Playback limits
limits.capped: The guest account limits this profile: {{summary}}.

state.network: Download interrupted, it tries again soon
state.range: The server does not send the file in parts (check the proxy)
state.budgetFull: Waiting for room on the server
state.paused: Paused, the server is streaming right now

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.intro: Titles {{name}} saved on this device. They play without a network too.

unsupported.title: Downloads are not possible here
unsupported.body: This browser cannot save titles. Downloads need a secure connection (HTTPS) and a current browser.

downloads.empty: No downloads on this device yet. Download films, episodes and whole seasons on their detail page.

delete.label: Delete {{title}}
delete.title: Delete the download {{title}}?
delete.body: The file is removed from this device. You can download the title again later.

downloads.offline: No connection to the server. Saved titles still play; changes reach the server at the next contact.

pinHint.title: PIN for offline use
pinHint.body: So that {{name}} opens offline on this device too, enter the profile's PIN here once.

storage.title: Storage
storage.unknown: Downloads: {{size}}. This browser does not tell the available storage.
storage.persisted: The browser keeps the downloads for good.
storage.notPersisted: The browser may delete the downloads when storage runs low.

apple.title: Note for iPhone, iPad and Safari
apple.body: Safari deletes the data of a web app that was not opened for a while. Open Slouchcat regularly to keep the downloads; as an app on the home screen they are better protected.

rules.title: Automatic downloads
rules.intro: Downloads the next episode of every series {{name}} watched in the last 60 days to this device, and new episodes of the podcasts {{name}} marked as favourites.
rules.wifiIos: iPhone and iPad do not tell the browser whether they are on Wi-Fi. Automatic downloads load there while the app is open.
rules.maxCount: At most this many unwatched episodes
rules.saved: Saved. The rule applies from the next sync.

dialog.title: Download {{title}}
dialog.intro: The title is saved on this device and plays without a network too.
dialog.seasonIntro_one: The only episode of this season is saved on this device.
dialog.seasonIntro_other: All {{count}} episodes of this season are saved on this device.
dialog.started_one: Download started. Its state is under Downloads.
dialog.started_other: {{count}} downloads started. Their state is under Downloads.

library.title: Offline library
library.intro: Who is watching? These profiles have downloads on this device.

empty.title: No downloads on this device
empty.body: Without a connection to the server only downloaded titles play.
empty.hint: Once you download titles online, you find them here without a network too.

locked.title: Downloads locked
locked.body: The account of this device signed out. The downloads stay stored and open again as soon as the same account signs in.

library.noneReady: No title is completely on this device yet.

pin.introOffline: This profile has its own offline PIN.
pin.offlineFormat: The offline PIN has 6 to 12 digits.

unavailable.title: Locked offline
unavailable.body: Enter this profile's PIN online on this device once, then it opens offline too.

player.failed: The saved file cannot be played.

missing.title: Download not available
missing.body: This download is not (or no longer) on this device, is not complete yet or is not released for this profile.

search.title: Search
search.label: Search term
search.start: Search for titles, people and collections, or pick a filter.

empty.title: Nothing found
empty.body: Try another term or fewer filters.

empty.title: Your watchlist is empty
empty.body: Keep titles for later with “Add to watchlist” on their detail page.

notFound.title: Collection not found
notFound.body: This collection does not exist or holds no title for this profile.

empty.title: No notifications
empty.body: Mark series or podcasts as favourites to hear about new episodes here.

notifications.title: Notification channels
notifications.intro: New episodes of your favourites, invitations and announcements arrive here in addition to the app’s inbox. The settings apply to the whole account with all its profiles; a message about a profile starts with its name.

unavailable.body: The main user sets up this channel in the administration under Integrations.

email.description: By default the address of your account.

push.subscribed: This device now receives push messages.
push.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push messages here. It takes a current browser and a connection over HTTPS.
push.ios: On iPhone and iPad, Web Push works only in the installed app: choose “Add to Home Screen” in the share menu and open Slouchcat from there.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for Slouchcat. Allow them in the browser’s settings.
push.noWorker: The service worker is not running yet. Reload the page and try again.
push.failed: The browser could not register with its push service.
